stableEgressRequiredKey.description: Live adapter that must remain on the governed stable-NAT worker. Not a production-authorization flag.

oneDotZero.description: Reviewed list of provider keys in the 1.0 scope, sorted, each present in providers. The provider permissions lint derives its required 1.0 coverage from this list.

liveAdapter.description: When true, a live deploy may list this key in WORKER_LIVE_ADAPTERS. Default for new entries is false. Never grants production authority.

adapterKind.description: Set to api for a provider reached over an HTTP API rather than a browser portal. An api provider may declare its key secret (name only) while liveAdapter is false; the generated helpers render secrets only for live adapters.

adoptedAdapter.description: Points the fixture kit at an existing hand-built adapter so fixture:onboard --stage=live does not generate a placeholder stub next to it. Only valid when liveAdapter is true.

sessionlessJustification.description: Required when liveAdapter is true and no session secret has requiredWhenListed true. Explains why the adapter can be listed without a generated required-secret check.

offHostAllowlist.description: Exact lowercase hostnames (no wildcards, ports, or paths), sorted, that the provider portal genuinely needs off its own hosts, for example a JS CDN. The portal kernel continues subresource requests to them instead of quietly blocking them; navigations and payload-bearing requests to them remain boundary violations. Absent by default. Never changes liveAdapter or egress.

secretNameEnv.description: Environment variable that holds the Secret Manager secret name, never a secret value. Must end in _SECRET_NAME and must not collide with deploy-script variables.

mountEnv.description: Worker environment variable that receives the named secret.

mountPath.description: Fixed Cloud Run secret mount path. Not a secret value.

requiredWhenListed.description: When true, a live deploy that lists this adapter must set secretNameEnv. When false, the generated helper still applies the secret if the env var is set and still removes a stale binding when the adapter is not listed, unless manualDeploy is true.

manualDeploy.description: When true, the generated deploy helper skips apply/remove for this secret because deploy-cloud-run.sh owns the binding. Restricted to the xometry allowlist; other providers are rejected. Required-secret checks and stale-remove steps for every other listed secret still run.
